name: A word stretches elastically into place
looks: A single bold word slams in with heavy motion blur, overshoots past its resting scale, and settles back with a visible elastic wobble, a small lower-case caption naming the easing style used ("elastic") sitting quietly beside it.
build: Word scales in from ~1.4x with directional motion blur tied to velocity, overshooting to ~0.95x before settling to 1x on a spring ease (response ~0.3, damping ~0.5) so two or three visible wobbles land before it's still. The caption fades in only once the word has fully settled.
sound: A heavy whoosh under the slam, a boingy twang under the settle wobble.
prompt: Slam a single bold word into frame with heavy motion blur, let it overshoot past its resting size and spring back with a visible wobble before settling still, naming the easing style in a small quiet caption only once it has fully stopped moving.
